title: Establishment of secure exchange of NAS messages

entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by MME to establish secure NAS message exchange by selecting security algorithms and activating integrity protection and ciphering.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE during tracking area updating procedure, used to trigger security context establishment during inter-system handovers.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Initial NAS message for attach procedure, used to establish secure NAS message exchange with various security contexts.

entities.name: EPS security context
entities.description: Security context used for integrity protection and ciphering of NAS messages in EPS network.

entities.name: Mapped EPS security context
entities.description: Security context derived from 5G NAS security context during inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode.

entities.name: eKSI
entities.description: EPS Key Set Identifier used to indicate the security context value in NAS messages.

entities.name: Integrity protection
entities.description: Security feature ensuring NAS message integrity using EPS security algorithms.

entities.name: Ciphering
entities.description: Security feature encrypting NAS messages using EPS security algorithms, except for messages specified in clause 4.4.5.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management state where UE has no active NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: EMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management state where UE has an active NAS signalling connection.

relations.description: Security mode control procedure establishes integrity protection for NAS messages.
Security mode control procedure establishes ciphering for NAS messages.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message requires integrity protection using mapped EPS security context during inter-system handover.
ATTACH REQUEST message contains eKSI information element indicating security context.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message contains eKSI information element indicating security context.
Security mode control procedure may be initiated when UE is in EMM-IDLE mode with valid security context.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message transmission during inter-system change requires EMM-CONNECTED mode.
Mapped EPS security context requires integrity protection for NAS messages.
Mapped EPS security context requires ciphering for NAS messages except those specified in clause 4.4.5.
